reviews.text:
A huge thank you to Marie for her invaluable support with Baya!

Marie is an incredibly patient and calming trainer. Baya adores her! What I appreciated most was her ability to constantly adapt: ​​she perfectly adjusts the program and sessions to suit the current challenges. She was particularly helpful in helping Baya overcome her anxieties about urban environments.

You can entrust your pet to her with complete confidence!
Awesome!

Marie is a fantastic trainer! Thanks to her, my dog ​​handles being alone incredibly well. The process required some effort, but what a success! Marie is always available and attentive. She was very responsive when my dog ​​became anxious and offered me tailored solutions. Her support is incredibly effective. A huge thank you to her!

We first met with Marie for a pre-adoption assessment so she could help us understand our needs and determine what kind of dog would be a good fit for our lifestyle, and this helped us find our puppy. We then saw her again for an assessment with our 3-month-old Westie.
Marie is a very attentive and caring trainer. She takes the time to explain things thoroughly, uses gentle techniques, and employs positive reinforcement. We are delighted to have her by our side.
We highly recommend her services!
We were very apprehensive about choosing a trainer. Marie is very competent and reassured us. She was kind and offered good advice with our first puppy, Cheddar.
Marie is a fantastic trainer; she's kind, attentive, and knows how to adapt to each dog. I highly recommend her!

It's been almost a year since we met Marie, initially for group walks, then for group classes, and also for an individual assessment for our 15-month-old Belgian Malinois mix. Moka adores her, and so do we.
Marie is professional, patient, and attentive to our needs as well as our constraints. She also brings a lot of positivity, which is so helpful when you're raising and training a dog.
We recommend her without hesitation.

Marie was recommended to us by our previous dog trainer, who has since moved away.

We regularly take walks and group classes with our one-year-old Shiba Inu. We are delighted! She gives excellent advice and is always very kind and supportive. 👍🏻
Marie always has great advice on dog training, I highly recommend her and thank you again!

Marie is a very good educator, I highly recommend her.
A kind person, attentive to everyone's needs 🙂 …

Looking for a dog trainer? Marie is the one for you!

I have a package of 5 sessions for my 4-month-old puppy.

Marie is patient and gentle! She takes the time to listen to us and guide us gently.

She adapts to our needs depending on the session.
Thanks to her guidance and advice, I can calmly and effectively train my puppy through various training stages.

Don't hesitate to contact her if you're looking for a fantastic dog trainer! ✨

And a little bonus: your pup will love her! 🐕

A very positive experience with Marie.
She has excellent knowledge of canine behavior, is very attentive to my needs, and adapts to each dog's pace.
I tried both individual and group classes.
I will continue with a few reinforcement sessions.
I highly recommend Marie! She was a great help to my visually impaired dog, Nao, with patience and kindness. Her advice is clear, and she's also very friendly and attentive. Thank you again! 🐾 …

Thank you to Marie for her patience and kindness with my dog ​​Rainy and me! She is always ready to help and offer invaluable advice on dog training and well-being. The classes she offers are always a tremendous source of inspiration and a pleasure shared with many other owners. I have enormous confidence in Marie; she is a passionate person who knows how to share her knowledge so that we can apply what we learn in the classes directly at home. Thank you again for everything, and see you soon!

Marie is a huge help with our little Caly. She's given us tons of tips for working on letting go, managing emotions, and handling people coming and going in our home! A major plus for us is that Marie knows mastiffs very well and gives us a lot of advice. Thanks again! 🫶🏻 …

Marie truly helped our dog calm down. It had become impossible to walk our 5-year-old corgi because of his fears and frustrations in the street. And, in just a few sessions, our dog lost his fears and rediscovered the joy of walks thanks to Marie's training tools and guidance.
She was always attentive and kind to both our dog and us. This experience allowed our dog to gain confidence and thrive.
Thank you again for your help; it has truly improved our daily life.
Marie has been taking care of Petit Loup since he came into our lives, with seriousness and professionalism :)
A fantastic trainer who was able to guide me with my border collie! Great advice and kindness!

A highly competent dog trainer who listens attentively to both owners and dogs. Our dog, Moka, has made great progress, and the lessons are always conducted with kindness and care. I highly recommend her. Thank you, Marie!

Marie is a fantastic trainer! She helped me train my little Vicko with great pleasure for both of us, and her training method is excellent.

I highly recommend this serious and very competent young woman.
Marie accompanied us with our dog, and her advice helped us understand him better. Thank you for your kindness and for listening.
